scope: Resolve the local sybase_timezone anchor and load BulkSqlUtil documentation tags from the Qore SDK. No native implementation changes. Optional Java binding generation is explicitly off for the FreeTDS RPM payload.

command:
set -eu
. /usr/lib/rpm/qore/module-env.sh
cd /source
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DWITH_FREETDS=ON -DWITH_SYBASE=OFF -DQORE_GENERATE_JAVA_BINDINGS=OFF
cmake --build build -j2
printf '\nWARN_AS_ERROR = FAIL_ON_WARNINGS\n' >> build/Doxyfile
cmake --build build --target docs -j2
python3 -B -W error rpm/test_fixture.py -v
python3 -B -W error rpm/run-tests.py --build-dir /source/build
